title: OmniFed: A Modular Framework for Configurable Federated Learning from Edge to HPC
problem: Federated learning needs modular, configurable infrastructure supporting edge-to-HPC deployments with privacy
motivation: Heterogeneous FL systems require separation of concerns, mixed protocols, and privacy mechanisms in a unified framework
method: OmniFed: modular framework with topology/protocol config, pluggable privacy (DP/HE/SA), compression, multiple training algorithms
key_novelty: Configuration-driven modular FL framework supporting mixed protocols and pluggable privacy/compression across heterogeneous environments
